body: Ang pinaka-worth exploring dito ay hindi ‘AI in CAE’ by itself, kundi whether distributed co-simulation can make supplier collaboration less painful without forcing full model disclosure. If that survives real interface/version-control problems, puwedeng maging useful bridge between OEM, equipment maker at specialist supplier. Sa event, hahanapin ko specifically ang demo na may two different toolchains and an actual model handoff—not another single-vendor happy path.

claims.text: Cross-company distributed co-simulation could reduce collaboration friction if interoperability and model-governance problems are handled in practice.
claims.basis: Inference from article-established capabilities and stated evidence boundary
